digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime authentication and ProviderSession integration
propositions: Add LLMRuntime capability class in src/rebar/llm/auth.py to accept provider-native auth/session inputs (boto3 Session, Anthropic token provider, OpenAI workload identity) without serialization or external visibility.
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to accept LLMRuntime and inject it into the single per-run ProviderSession builder for each provider.
Ensure exactly one Rebar-owned official client is constructed and closed per run; provider-native auth reaches only the existing builder without forking or creating alternate clients.
Auth injection must fail before provider model request if explicit auth is missing or conflicting; no fallback to anonymous, alternate principals, or cross-provider candidates.
Credential material and auth capabilities must remain non-serializable and excluded from LLMConfig, RunRequest, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, CLI schemas, and public outputs.
RP-01 authoritative behavior (request budget, output repair, cache, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, failure handling) and one-Agent operation remain unchanged and unforked.
